_comment: Each entry maps a sibling content repo to destination paths inside this repo. Paths are relative to the repo root. Local dev reads the sibling folders next to this repo; CI checks them out side by side (see .github/workflows/deploy.yml).
_kind: `kind` selects the destination (content/<kind>/ + public/media/<kind>/). Supported: stories | notes | albums. It replaces matching on the repository name, so extra repositories of an existing kind are added by name alone.
_addingMoreGalleries: GitHub caps each repository at roughly 1 GB, so photos and videos can be spread over several repositories (my-album, my-album-2, my-album-3, ...). Add one entry per repository with kind=albums and check the extra repositories out in .github/workflows/deploy.yml; nothing else changes. One rule: the immediate subfolder names inside each repository become album slugs, so they must be unique across all repositories of the same kind (use `street-2024` in the second gallery rather than reusing `travel`).
